subject: Renewal paperwork: term shift + capacity addendum sequencing
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@cloudcrest.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SaaS Procurement <procurement@cloudcrest.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal + draft redlines (term & capacity)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the conversation last week. Per our internal planning cycle we want to finalize the renewal paperwork this month. CloudCrest is proposing: a 24-month term (vs. our current 12), +40% committed capacity uplift in Exhibit B starting month 2, and a one-time onboarding credit for the additional capacity.

Attached are our suggested redlines (CloudCrest_Renewal_Redline_v3.docx) and a simple capacity worksheet that maps projected token consumption to tiered pricing. Key asks:
- Confirm the effective date for the expanded capacity and proration approach.
- We need a clause that allows a 90-day trial of burst capacity for the first quarter of the renewal term.
- Can Redwood provide a list of the SLAs we will get under the 24-month reserved commitment?

We're hoping to route final counter-signature through DocuSign by 3/20. Can you confirm next steps and who from your legal team should review?

Thanks —
Alex Rivera
Head of Cloud Partnerships
CloudCrest Technologies

Attachments: CloudCrest_Renewal_Redline_v3.docx (docx, 128 KB), capacity-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx, 24 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@cloudcrest.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Mar 2029 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + draft redlines (term & capacity)

Alex — thanks, received and reviewed the high level. Quick responses up front: 24 months is doable, we can support a month-2 effective start for the committed uplift with pro rata billing for the first month, and we generally can offer a 90-day burst pilot but need to narrow the operational guardrails.

Looping in Laura (legal) for redline review and Ben for commercial/discount approval. Marcus from Customer Success is on for onboarding timing and the pilot plan. Laura — can you take the CloudCrest redlines and flag any MSA language that prevents a 90-day burst pilot or changes needed for proration? Prefer we avoid addenda that break downstream billing flows.

Proposed next steps:
1) Legal to provide a consolidated mark (we prefer to do a single counter-redline document so both sides work off the same file).
2) Commercial to confirm final list price and any one-time credits.
3) Ops/CS to confirm a technical runbook for the burst trial (metrics, rollback).

If legal can turn the first pass by EOD 3/6, we can get internal approvals and share a consolidated counter by 3/11 and aim for DocuSign routing the week of 3/18.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Director — Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Mar 2029 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + draft redlines (term & capacity)

Team — reviewed CloudCrest_Renewal_Redline_v3.docx and the Exhibit B draft. High level legal notes (first pass):

1) 90-day burst pilot: we can add a scoped, timeboxed pilot clause but must limit it to specific endpoints and capped token volume to avoid open-ended liability. Recommend: a separate short addendum (Pilot Addendum) that references the MSA and Exhibit B and defines metrics, cap, and rollback.

2) Proration: their ask to start uplift in month 2 is fine; we need to clearly define the billing period alignment (calendar month vs. invoice period). We should include sample proration math in Exhibit B appendix.

3) SLA references: CloudCrest asked for a list of SLAs — copy the Dedicated SLA section into Exhibit A and specify which SLAs apply to the committed pool vs burst. Avoid pointing to ambiguous "platform availability" language — use numeric targets.

4) Indemnity/PCI/GDPR carveouts: their redlines added an operational data-sharing paragraph we need to redraft to preserve Redwood's standard limitations.

5) Signpath & sequencing: we can accept DocuSign routing. Legal prefers to have DevOps/Platform sign-off on any pilot runbook before countersignature.

I'll produce a consolidated counter-redline (tracked changes) that preserves their commercial asks where possible but protects the MSA language. Targeting EOD 3/6 as Marissa asked.

Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_Exhibit-B-draft.pdf (pdf, 64 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@cloudcrest.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2029 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Consolidated counter + next steps

Alex — attaching our consolidated counter (final tracked file in original thread). Summary of changes in the counter:
- We accepted the 24-month term and the +40% committed uplift start in month 2 with pro rata billing for month 2.
- We replaced the cloud-only wording for the burst pilot with a Pilot Addendum (we attached MSA_Exhibit-B-draft.pdf) that limits endpoints and sets a 500k token cap for the trial, plus explicit rollback conditions.
- Clarified SLA mapping for committed vs burst pools and added an Exhibit A reference with numeric targets.
- Preserved Redwood's standard liability cap and redrafted the operational data-sharing paragraph to avoid open-ended obligations.

Commercial ask: CloudCrest requested a one-time onboarding credit of $45,000. Ben — can you confirm approval or suggest a counter number? If approved, we'll include the credit in the DocuSign order form and route for signature.

Ops/CS ask (Marcus) — please confirm whether the token cap & endpoints are operationally acceptable and if the pilot runbook can be finished by 3/14.

If all aligns, legal will produce the final sign-ready DocuSign packet and Marissa will route for approvals; target signature window 3/18-3/22.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Director — Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: consolidated_counter_redlines.docx (docx, 140 KB), MSA_Exhibit-B-draft.pdf (pdf, 64 KB)
